## Define constants

```{r}
ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR = 2022
ZMB_CENSUS_POP = 10868136 # ages 15-64

# DALY calculation parameters
discount_percent = 0.03
discount_percent_high = 0.06
discount_start_year = 2025
```

## Define functions

These are functions for confidence interval calculations

```{r}
bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}

calculate.CI.by.metric = function(data, scenario.name, metric, n = 500){
  bt_resamples <- bootstraps(data %>% filter(scenario_name == scenario.name), times = n)
  
  bt_resamples$mean.metric <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, metric)
  metric_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.metric, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  return(
      data.frame(
      scenario_name = scenario.name, 
      metric = metric,
      metric.mean = mean(bt_resamples$mean.metric),
      metric.lb = metric_95[[1]], 
      metric.ub = metric_95[[2]]
    )
  )
}

format_sig3 <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(val) > 0 & abs(val) < 1) {
      formatC(signif(val, 3), digits=3, format="fg", flag="#")
    } else {
      formatC(round(val), format="d")
    }
  }, character(1))
}
```

# Load data

## Identify folders to read in

```{r}
outputs_dir <- "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/INSPIRE/Costing"
scenarios_file <- "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/scenarios_ce.csv"

#-----------------------------
# Read scenarios
#-----------------------------
scenarios <- read_csv(scenarios_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(Scenario)

#-----------------------------
# List output directories
#-----------------------------
dirs <- list.dirs(outputs_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

dir_df <- tibble(
  path = dirs,
  folder = basename(dirs)
)

#-----------------------------
# Function to parse folder names
# Expected format:
# Baseline-campaign_zmb_inspire_AYA_artdrop-<scenario>___YYYY_MM_DD_HH_MM_SS_microsec
#-----------------------------
parse_folder <- function(folder_name) {
  timestamp_raw <- str_extract(folder_name, "(?<=___)\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d+$")
  prefix_part <- str_remove(folder_name, "___\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_\\d+$")
  scenario <- str_extract(prefix_part, "[^-]+$")
  
  tibble(
    folder = folder_name,
    Scenario = scenario,
    timestamp_raw = timestamp_raw
  )
}

parsed_dirs <- map_dfr(dir_df$folder, parse_folder) %>%
  left_join(dir_df, by = "folder") %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(
      str_replace(timestamp_raw, "^([0-9]{4})_([0-9]{2})_([0-9]{2})_([0-9]{2})_([0-9]{2})_([0-9]{2}).*$", 
                  "\\1-\\2-\\3 \\4:\\5:\\6"),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  )

#-----------------------------
# Keep only folders matching scenarios in CSV
#-----------------------------
matched <- parsed_dirs %>%
  semi_join(scenarios, by = "Scenario")

#-----------------------------
# For each scenario, keep the most recent folder
#-----------------------------
scenario_paths <- matched %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = timestamp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Scenario, path)

#-----------------------------
# If you want all scenarios from CSV retained,
# including those with no matching folder:
#-----------------------------
scenario_paths_all <- scenarios %>%
  left_join(scenario_paths, by = "Scenario")
```

```{r}
## Read in Data for baseline

# DALY metrics too

data_by_age_year <- sim.results %>%
  filter(Year >= 2025.5) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
     Infected = sum(Infected),
     On_ART = sum(On_ART),
     pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
     .groups = "drop_last"
   )

data_by_age_year$Year_Integer <- floor((data_by_age_year$Year-0.5))

m2 <- data_by_age_year %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
          Infected = mean(Infected),
          On_ART = mean(On_ART),
          pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
          .groups = "drop_last"
         )

m2 <- m2 %>%
        mutate(On_ART_calib = On_ART*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_calib = Infected*pop_scaling_factor,
        Died_from_HIV_calib = Died_from_HIV*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_off_ART_calib = (Infected - On_ART)*pop_scaling_factor)

m2$Age <- ifelse(m2$Age >life_expectancy, life_expectancy, m2$Age)

m3 <- m2 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
      dplyr::select(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix, 
                    Died_from_HIV_calib, Infected_off_ART_calib, On_ART_calib) %>%
      dplyr::summarise_all(list(median=median))

disability.tibble <- m3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    infected_untreated = sum(Infected_off_ART_calib_median),
    on_art = sum(On_ART_calib_median)
    ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = Year_Integer)

m4 <- m3 %>% mutate(year_applied = Year_Integer - (Age - (life_expectancy + 1)))

daly.tibble <- merge(
  tibble(scenario_name_ = scenario.names),
  tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ),
  all = TRUE
) %>% 
  merge(  tibble(sim.ix = seq(1,10)), all=TRUE)

daly_expanded <- tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ) %>% 
  crossing(
    sim.ix = unique(m4$sim.ix),
    scenario_name = unique(m4$scenario_name)
  )

yll <- daly_expanded %>%
  left_join(m4, by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")) %>%
  filter(Year_Integer <= year, year_applied > year) %>%
  group_by(year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(
    yll = sum(Died_from_HIV_calib_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daly = left_join(
  yll, 
  disability.tibble, 
  by=c("year", "sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>%
 replace(is.na(.), 0)

daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly = infected_untreated*infected_weight + on_art*art_weight + yll)
daly <- daly %>% mutate(
  discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(year - discount_start_year),
  discount_factor_high = (1 - discount_percent_high)^(year - discount_start_year)
  ) 
daly[daly$year < discount_start_year,'discount_factor'] <- 1.0
daly <- daly %>% mutate(
  daly_future_discounted = daly*discount_factor,
  daly_future_discounted_high = daly*discount_factor_high
)

# Intermediate table!
HIV.DALYs <- daly %>% select(
  Year = year, 
  scenario_name,
  sim.ix,
  HIV.DALY = daly,
  HIV.DALY.discounted = daly_future_discounted,
  HIV.DALY.discounted_high = daly_future_discounted_high)

# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted),
            HIV.DALY.discounted_high = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted_high), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 


HIV.DALYs.agg %>% 
  mutate(scenario_name = 'baseline.reference') %>% 
  write_csv("Inspire_Costing_V2/Inspire_costing_baseline_reference_daly_raw_data.csv")
```

## Metrics calculation loop

```{r}
data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya.baseline.ref <- read_csv("Inspire_Costing_V2/Inspire_costing_baseline_reference_aya_raw_data.csv")
data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.all.baseline.ref <- read_csv("Inspire_Costing_V2/Inspire_costing_baseline_reference_all_raw_data.csv")
HIV.DALYs.agg.baseline.ref <- read_csv("Inspire_Costing_V2/Inspire_costing_baseline_reference_daly_raw_data.csv")

for (i in 1:nrow(scenario_paths_all)){

  ## Read in Data
  
  scenario.name = scenario_paths_all$Scenario[i]
  experiment.path = scenario_paths_all$path[i]
  
  sim.results <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
    experiment_path = experiment.path,
    scenario_name =  scenario.name,
    summarize_columns = c("Population","Infected", "On_ART",
                        "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                        "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
                        "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE","PrEP_INSPIRE","OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer"
                        ),
    stratify_columns = c("Year", "Age", "Gender"),
    min_age_inclusive = 0,
    max_age_inclusive = 99
  )
  
  sim.results.pop.scaling <- sim.results %>%
    filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
    filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>% 
    group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
    summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
    mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)
  
  sim.results <- sim.results %>%
    inner_join(
      sim.results.pop.scaling,
      by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
    )
  
  ## Analyze, AYA
  
  time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya <- sim.results %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2046, Age >= 15, Age < 25) %>% 
    mutate(Year = ceiling(Year) - 1) %>% 
    group_by(Year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Population = sum(Population*pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
              Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
              ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum( ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
              PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor), 
              OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor), 
              .groups = 'drop_last'
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(Off_ART = PLHIV - On_ART) 
  
  time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya %>%
    mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(Year - discount_start_year),
           discount_factor_high = (1 - discount_percent_high)^(Year - discount_start_year)) %>%
    mutate(
      On_ART.discount = On_ART * discount_factor,
      ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount = ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * discount_factor,
      PrEP_INSPIRE.discount = PrEP_INSPIRE * discount_factor,
      OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount = OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * discount_factor,
      On_ART.discount_high = On_ART * discount_factor_high,
      ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount_high = ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * discount_factor_high,
      PrEP_INSPIRE.discount_high = PrEP_INSPIRE * discount_factor_high,
      OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount_high = OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * discount_factor_high
    )
  
  data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya %>% 
    group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
    summarize(Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected),
              Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
              On_ART = sum(On_ART), 
              On_ART.discount = sum(On_ART.discount),
              On_ART.discount_high = sum(On_ART.discount_high),
              Off_ART = sum(Off_ART),
              ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
              ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount),
              ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount_high = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount_high),
              PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE),
              PrEP_INSPIRE.discount = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE.discount),
              PrEP_INSPIRE.discount_high = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE.discount_high),
              OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer),
              OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount),
              OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount_high = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount_high),
              .groups = 'drop_last'
    ) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya <- data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya %>% 
    merge(
      data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya.baseline.ref %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             Newly.Infected.baseline = Newly.Infected,
             Died_from_HIV.baseline = Died_from_HIV,
             On_ART.baseline = On_ART, 
             On_ART.discount.baseline = On_ART.discount, 
             On_ART.discount_high.baseline = On_ART.discount_high, 
             Off_ART.baseline = Off_ART),
    by = c("sim.ix")
  ) %>% 
    mutate(Newly.Infected.diff = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
           Died_from_HIV.diff = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.baseline,
           On_ART.diff = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
           On_ART.discount.diff = On_ART.discount - On_ART.discount.baseline,
           On_ART.discount_high.diff = On_ART.discount_high - On_ART.discount_high.baseline,
           Off_ART.diff = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline) %>% 
    mutate(Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.diff/Newly.Infected.baseline,
           Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.diff/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
           On_ART.pct = On_ART.diff/On_ART, 
           On_ART.discount.pct = On_ART.discount.diff/On_ART.discount, 
           On_ART.discount_high.pct = On_ART.discount_high.diff/On_ART.discount_high, 
           Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.diff/Off_ART)
  
  
  ## Analyze, all
  
  time.series.metrics.disaggregated.all <- sim.results %>% 
    filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2046, Age >= 15) %>% 
    mutate(Year = ceiling(Year) - 1) %>% 
    group_by(Year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
    summarize(Population = sum(Population*pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
              On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)/2,

        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount_high")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
                  
      }

    if( scenario.name %in% c("prep", "sa_prep_duration_lb", "sa_prep_duration_ub", "sa_prep_eff_lb",  "sa_prep_eff_ub")){
      
      h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
            data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
            scenario.name = scenario.name,
            metric = "PREP.cost")
      A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
      
      h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
            data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
            scenario.name = scenario.name,
            metric = "PREP.discount.cost")
      A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
       
      h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
            data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
            scenario.name = scenario.name,
            metric = "PREP.discount_high.cost")
      A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)     

      h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
            data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
            scenario.name = scenario.name,
            metric = "ARTcosts_fraction")
      A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
      
      h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
            data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
            scenario.name = scenario.name,
            metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount")
      A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

      h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
            data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
            scenario.name = scenario.name,
            metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount_high")
      A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

    }

    if( scenario.name %in% c("zaimara", "sa_zaimara_eff_lb", "sa_zaimara_eff_lb", 
                         "sa_zaimara_reach_lb", "sa_zaimara_reach_ub", "sa_zaimara_duration_lb", "sa_zaimara_duration_ub")){
      
        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ZAIMARA.cost")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
        
        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ZAIMARA.discount.cost")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ZAIMARA.discount_high.cost")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
                
        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ARTcosts_fraction")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
        
        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
        
        h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
          data = A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
          scenario.name = scenario.name,
          metric = "ARTcosts_fraction.discount_high")
        A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)  
      }
  
  rbind(metrics.A1599 %>% mutate(age = "[15,99)"), 
        metrics.A1525 %>% mutate(age = "[15,25)")) %>% 
    select("scenario_name", "metric", "age", "metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub") %>% 
    write_csv(paste0("Inspire_Costing_V2/Basic_Metrics_with_CIs/basic_metrics_with_CIs_",scenario.name,".csv"))

  if (nrow(A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs)>0){
    A1599.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs %>% write_csv(paste0("Inspire_Costing_V2/Basic_Metrics_with_CIs/costing_metrics_",scenario.name,".csv"))
  }
}
```

Recalculating costing stuff
### Recalculating DALYs
```{r}
## DALY Calculations
data_by_age_year <- inspire.daly.results %>%
  filter(Year >= 2025.5) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
     Infected = sum(Infected),
     On_ART = sum(On_ART),
     pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
     .groups = "drop_last"
   )

data_by_age_year$Year_Integer <- floor((data_by_age_year$Year-0.5))
  
m2 <- data_by_age_year %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
          Infected = mean(Infected),
          On_ART = mean(On_ART),
          pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
          .groups = "drop_last"
         )

m2 <- m2 %>%
        mutate(On_ART_calib = On_ART*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_calib = Infected*pop_scaling_factor,
        Died_from_HIV_calib = Died_from_HIV*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_off_ART_calib = (Infected - On_ART)*pop_scaling_factor)

m2$Age <- ifelse(m2$Age >life_expectancy, life_expectancy, m2$Age)

m3 <- m2 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
      dplyr::select(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix, 
                    Died_from_HIV_calib, Infected_off_ART_calib, On_ART_calib) %>%
      dplyr::summarise_all(list(median=median))

disability.tibble <- m3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    infected_untreated = sum(Infected_off_ART_calib_median),
    on_art = sum(On_ART_calib_median)
    ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = Year_Integer)

m4 <- m3 %>% mutate(year_applied = Year_Integer - (Age - (life_expectancy + 1)))

daly.tibble <- merge(
  tibble(scenario_name_ = scenario.names),
  tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ),
  all = TRUE
) %>% 
  merge(  tibble(sim.ix = seq(1,10)), all=TRUE)

daly_expanded <- tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ) %>% 
  crossing(
    sim.ix = unique(m4$sim.ix),
    scenario_name = unique(m4$scenario_name)
  )

yll <- daly_expanded %>%
  left_join(m4, by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")) %>%
  filter(Year_Integer <= year, year_applied > year) %>%
  group_by(year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(
    yll = sum(Died_from_HIV_calib_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daly = left_join(
  yll, 
  disability.tibble, 
  by=c("year", "sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>%
 replace(is.na(.), 0)

daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly = infected_untreated*infected_weight + on_art*art_weight + yll)
daly <- daly %>% mutate(
  discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(year - discount_start_year),
  discount_factor_high = (1 - discount_percent_high)^(year - discount_start_year)
  ) 
daly[daly$year < discount_start_year,'discount_factor'] <- 1.0
daly <- daly %>% mutate(
  daly_future_discounted = daly*discount_factor,
  daly_future_discounted_high = daly*discount_factor_high
)

# Intermediate table!
HIV.DALYs <- daly %>% select(
  Year = year, 
  scenario_name,
  sim.ix,
  HIV.DALY = daly,
  HIV.DALY.discounted = daly_future_discounted,
  HIV.DALY.discounted_high = daly_future_discounted_high)

# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted),
            HIV.DALY.discounted_high = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted_high), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 

# Stop here, need to calculate DALYs relative to new baseline.

HIV.DALYs.agg$scenario_name <- HIV.DALYs.agg$scenario_short

HIV.DALYs.agg.lb <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_short == "sa_artdrop_lb") %>% 
  merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_short == "sa_artdrop_baseline_lb") %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted,
             HIV.DALY.discounted_high.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted_high),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted_high.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted_high - HIV.DALY.discounted_high.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted,
    HIV.DALY.discounted_high.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted_high.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted_high
  )


HIV.DALYs.agg.ub <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_short == "sa_artdrop_ub") %>% 
  merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_short == "sa_artdrop_baseline_ub") %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted,
             HIV.DALY.discounted_high.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted_high),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted_high.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted_high - HIV.DALY.discounted_high.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted,
    HIV.DALY.discounted_high.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted_high.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted_high
  )

# Calculate DALYs
daly.metric.names = c(
  "HIV.DALY", "HIV.DALY.discounted", "HIV.DALY.discounted_high",
  "HIV.DALY.diff", "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff", "HIV.DALY.discounted_high.diff",
  "HIV.DALY.pct", "HIV.DALY.discounted.pct", "HIV.DALY.discounted.pct", "HIV.DALY.discounted_high.pct"
)

sa.artdrop.metrics <- data.frame()

for (j in daly.metric.names){
  #print(c(i,j))
  h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
    data = HIV.DALYs.agg.ub,
    scenario.name = "sa_artdrop_ub",
    metric = j)
  
  sa.artdrop.metrics = rbind(sa.artdrop.metrics, h)
  
  h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
    data = HIV.DALYs.agg.lb,
    scenario.name = "sa_artdrop_lb",
    metric = j)
  
  sa.artdrop.metrics = rbind(sa.artdrop.metrics, h)

}
```

### Assemble all artdrop data
```{r}
data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.artdrop.sa.lb <- data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.artdrop.sa %>% 
  filter(scenario_name == "sa_artdrop_lb") %>% 
  merge(
    data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.artdrop.sa %>% 
      filter(scenario_name == "sa_artdrop_baseline_lb") %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
           Newly.Infected.baseline = Newly.Infected,
           Died_from_HIV.baseline = Died_from_HIV,
           On_ART.baseline = On_ART, 
           On_ART.discount.baseline = On_ART.discount, 
           On_ART.discount_high.baseline = On_ART.discount_high, 
           Off_ART.baseline = Off_ART),
    by = c("sim.ix")
```

```{r}
# List files
all_files <- list.files(path = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Costing_V2/Basic_Metrics_with_CIs", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Split into groups
basic_files <- all_files[str_detect(basename(all_files), "^basic_metrics")]
costing_files <- all_files[str_detect(basename(all_files), "^costing_metrics")]

# Function to read and stack files
read_and_stack <- function(files) {
  map_dfr(files, function(f) {
    read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(source_file = basename(f))
  })
}

# Read and combine
basic_metrics_df <- read_and_stack(basic_files)
costing_metrics_df <- read_and_stack(costing_files)

basic_metrics_df %>% write_csv(file = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Costing_V2/analysis_basic_metrics.csv")

costing_metrics_df %>% write_csv(file = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Costing_V2/analysis_costing_metrics.csv")
```

```{r}
basic_metrics_df <- read_csv("/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Costing_V2/analysis_basic_metrics.csv")

fmt_sig <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    format(signif(x, digits), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
  )
}

# If you want M/B suffixes instead of full numbers:
fmt_sig_compact <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    val <- signif(val, digits)
    abs_val <- abs(val)
    
    if (abs_val >= 1e9) {
      paste0(format(val / 1e9, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "B")
    } else if (abs_val >= 1e6) {
      paste0(format(val / 1e6, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "M")
    } else if (abs_val >= 1e3) {
      format(val, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
    } else {
      format(val, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
    }
  })
}
```

## Percent differences metrics tables

```{r}
# ---------- percent formatting helper ----------
fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    
    pct <- signif(val * 100, digits)
    
    decimals <- max(digits - 1 - floor(log10(abs(pct))), 0)
    if (pct == 0) decimals <- digits - 1
    
    paste0(
      if (pct > 0) "+" else "",
      formatC(pct, format = "f", digits = decimals),
      "%"
    )
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# ---------- build percentage table ----------
pct_table_all <- basic_metrics_df %>%
  filter(
    age == "[15,99)",
    scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "artdrop", "zaimara", "prep"),
    metric %in% c(
      "Newly.Infected.pct",
      "Died_from_HIV.pct",
      "On_ART.pct",
      "Off_ART.pct"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      metric,
      "Newly.Infected.pct" = "HIV Acquisitions (95% CI)",
      "Died_from_HIV.pct"  = "HIV Deaths",
      "On_ART.pct"         = "Person-Years on ART",
      "Off_ART.pct"        = "Person-Years off ART"
    ),
    Scenario = recode(
      scenario_name,
      "baseline" = "Baseline",
      "artdrop"  = "ART Retention",
      "zaimara"  = "ZAIMARA",
      "prep"     = "PrEP"
    ),
    value = case_when(
      scenario_name == "baseline" ~ "0",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        fmt_pct(metric.mean), " (",
        fmt_pct(metric.lb), "— ", fmt_pct(metric.ub), ")"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Scenario, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "HIV Acquisitions (95% CI)",
        "HIV Deaths",
        "Person-Years on ART",
        "Person-Years off ART"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Metric)

pct_table_aya <- basic_metrics_df %>%
  filter(
    age == "[15,25)",
    scenario_name %in% c("baseline", "artdrop", "zaimara", "prep"),
    metric %in% c(
      "Newly.Infected.pct",
      "Died_from_HIV.pct",
      "On_ART.pct",
      "Off_ART.pct"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      metric,
      "Newly.Infected.pct" = "HIV Acquisitions (95% CI)",
      "Died_from_HIV.pct"  = "HIV Deaths",
      "On_ART.pct"         = "Person-Years on ART",
      "Off_ART.pct"        = "Person-Years off ART"
    ),
    Scenario = recode(
      scenario_name,
      "baseline" = "Baseline",
      "artdrop"  = "ART Retention",
      "zaimara"  = "ZAIMARA",
      "prep"     = "PrEP"
    ),
    value = case_when(
      scenario_name == "baseline" ~ "0",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        fmt_pct(metric.mean), " (",
        fmt_pct(metric.lb), "— ", fmt_pct(metric.ub), ")"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Scenario, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "HIV Acquisitions (95% CI)",
        "HIV Deaths",
        "Person-Years on ART",
        "Person-Years off ART"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Metric)

pct_table_aya %>% select(1,3,2,5,4)

pct_table_all %>% select(1,3,2,5,4)
```

## Costing estimates

```{r}
costing_metrics_df <- read_csv("/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/ZMB_calib_202206/Analysis/Inspire_Costing_V2/analysis_costing_metrics.csv")


# ---------------- formatters ----------------
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    out <- signif(val, digits)
    format(out, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

fmt_cell <- function(mean, lb, ub, digits = 3) {
  paste0(
    fmt_num(mean, digits), " (",
    fmt_num(lb, digits), "– ",
    fmt_num(ub, digits), ")"
  )
}

# ---------------- DALY row 1 ----------------
daly_row <- bind_rows(
  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "HIV.DALY.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention, Defaulter Tracing"),

  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "HIV.DALY.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention Maintenance"),

  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "zaimara", metric == "HIV.DALY.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ZAIMARA"),

  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "prep", metric == "HIV.DALY.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "PrEP")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = "DALYs Averted (95% CI)",
    value = fmt_cell(metric.mean, metric.lb, metric.ub)
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Scenario, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value)

# ---------------- DALY row 2 ----------------
daly_disc_row <- bind_rows(
  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention, Defaulter Tracing"),

  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention Maintenance"),

  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "zaimara", metric == "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ZAIMARA"),

  basic_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "prep", metric == "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "PrEP")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = "DALYs Averted, discounted",
    value = fmt_cell(metric.mean, metric.lb, metric.ub)
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Scenario, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value)

# ---------------- cost row ----------------
cost_row <- bind_rows(
  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "ART.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention, Defaulter Tracing"),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "ART.maintenance.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention Maintenance"),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "zaimara", metric == "ZAIMARA.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ZAIMARA"),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "prep", metric == "PREP.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "PrEP")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = "Upper Bound Cost (2025 USD)",
    value = fmt_cell(metric.mean, metric.lb, metric.ub)
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Scenario, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value)

# ---------------- cost row 2 ----------------
cost_row_2 <- bind_rows(
  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "ART.discount.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention, Defaulter Tracing"),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "artdrop", metric == "ART.maintenance.discount.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ART Retention Maintenance"),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "zaimara", metric == "ZAIMARA.discount.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "ZAIMARA"),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "prep", metric == "PREP.discount.cost") %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "PrEP")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = "Upper Bound Cost, Discounted (2025 USD)",
    value = fmt_cell(metric.mean, metric.lb, metric.ub)
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, Scenario, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = value)

# ---------------- final table ----------------
cost_table <- bind_rows(
  daly_row,
  daly_disc_row,
  cost_row,
  cost_row_2
)

cost_table %>% select(2,3,4,5)
```

```{r}
sim.results.pop.scaling <- inspire.daly.results %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

inspire.daly.results <- inspire.daly.results %>%
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
```

### Plots data
```{r}
adults.plot.dat <- inspire.daly.results %>%
  filter(Age >= 15) %>%
  mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
            On_ART = mean(On_ART),
            Off_ART = mean(Off_ART)
            )

adults.plot.dat$scenario <- factor(adults.plot.dat$scenario_name, levels = c( "baseline", "art", "prep","zaimara"))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(tibble)

scenario_map <- tribble(
  ~scenario_name,              ~baseline_group, ~metric,         ~label,                     ~bound,
  "sa_artdrop_baseline_lb",    "artdrop",       "ART.cost",      "Baseline cost",            "lb",
  "sa_artdrop_baseline_ub",    "artdrop",       "ART.cost",      "Baseline cost",            "ub",
  "sa_artdrop_lb",             "artdrop",       "ART.cost",      "Defaulter tracing effect", "lb",
  "sa_artdrop_ub",             "artdrop",       "ART.cost",      "Defaulter tracing effect", "ub",
  "sa_prep_duration_lb",       "prep",          "PREP.cost",     "PrEP duration",            "lb",
  "sa_prep_duration_ub",       "prep",          "PREP.cost",     "PrEP duration",            "ub",
  "sa_prep_eff_lb",            "prep",          "PREP.cost",     "PrEP efficacy",            "lb",
  "sa_prep_eff_ub",            "prep",          "PREP.cost",     "PrEP efficacy",            "ub",
  "sa_zaimara_duration_lb",    "zaimara",       "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA duration",         "lb",
  "sa_zaimara_duration_ub",    "zaimara",       "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA duration",         "ub",
  "sa_zaimara_eff_lb",         "zaimara",       "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA efficacy",         "lb",
  "sa_zaimara_reach_lb",       "zaimara",       "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA reach",            "lb",
  "sa_zaimara_reach_ub",       "zaimara",       "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA reach",            "ub"
)

baseline_vals <- costing_metrics_df %>%
  filter(
    (scenario_name == "artdrop" & metric == "ART.cost") |
    (scenario_name == "prep"    & metric == "PREP.cost") |
    (scenario_name == "zaimara" & metric == "ZAIMARA.cost")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    baseline_group = scenario_name,
    metric,
    baseline_value = metric.mean
  )

sa_plot_df <- costing_metrics_df %>%
  inner_join(scenario_map, by = c("scenario_name", "metric")) %>%
  select(scenario_name, baseline_group, metric, label, bound, metric.mean) %>%
  left_join(baseline_vals, by = c("baseline_group", "metric")) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change = 100 * (metric.mean - baseline_value) / baseline_value
  )

sa_plot_wide <- sa_plot_df %>%
  select(baseline_group, label, bound, pct_change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bound, values_from = pct_change) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_group = factor(
      baseline_group,
      levels = c("artdrop", "prep", "zaimara"),
      labels = c("ART Retention, Defaulter Tracing", "PrEP", "ZAIMARA")
    )
  )

ggplot(sa_plot_wide) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_col(aes(x = lb, y = fct_rev(label)), fill = "#1f3bff", width = 0.32) +
  geom_col(aes(x = ub, y = fct_rev(label)), fill = "#c62d12", width = 0.32) +
  facet_wrap(~ baseline_group, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(tibble)

scenario_map <- tribble(
  ~scenario_name,           ~reference_scenario,         ~metric,         ~label,                     ~bound, ~group,
  "sa_artdrop_lb",          "sa_artdrop_baseline_lb",    "ART.cost",      "Defaulter tracing effect", "lb",   "artdrop",
  "sa_artdrop_ub",          "sa_artdrop_baseline_ub",    "ART.cost",      "Defaulter tracing effect", "ub",   "artdrop",

  "sa_prep_duration_lb",    "prep",                      "PREP.cost",     "PrEP duration",            "lb",   "prep",
  "sa_prep_duration_ub",    "prep",                      "PREP.cost",     "PrEP duration",            "ub",   "prep",
  "sa_prep_eff_lb",         "prep",                      "PREP.cost",     "PrEP efficacy",            "lb",   "prep",
  "sa_prep_eff_ub",         "prep",                      "PREP.cost",     "PrEP efficacy",            "ub",   "prep",

  "sa_zaimara_duration_lb", "zaimara",                   "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA duration",         "lb",   "zaimara",
  "sa_zaimara_duration_ub", "zaimara",                   "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA duration",         "ub",   "zaimara",
  "sa_zaimara_eff_lb",      "zaimara",                   "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA efficacy",         "lb",   "zaimara",
  "sa_zaimara_reach_lb",    "zaimara",                   "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA reach",            "lb",   "zaimara",
  "sa_zaimara_reach_ub",    "zaimara",                   "ZAIMARA.cost",  "ZAIMARA reach",            "ub",   "zaimara"
)

reference_vals <- bind_rows(
  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "sa_artdrop_baseline_lb", metric == "ART.cost") %>%
    transmute(reference_scenario = scenario_name, metric, reference_value = metric.mean),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "sa_artdrop_baseline_ub", metric == "ART.cost") %>%
    transmute(reference_scenario = scenario_name, metric, reference_value = metric.mean),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "prep", metric == "PREP.cost") %>%
    transmute(reference_scenario = scenario_name, metric, reference_value = metric.mean),

  costing_metrics_df %>%
    filter(scenario_name == "zaimara", metric == "ZAIMARA.cost") %>%
    transmute(reference_scenario = scenario_name, metric, reference_value = metric.mean)
)

sa_plot_df <- costing_metrics_df %>%
  inner_join(scenario_map, by = c("scenario_name", "metric")) %>%
  left_join(reference_vals, by = c("reference_scenario", "metric")) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change = 100 * (metric.mean - reference_value) / reference_value
  )

sa_plot_wide <- sa_plot_df %>%
  select(group, label, bound, pct_change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bound, values_from = pct_change) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("artdrop", "prep", "zaimara"),
      labels = c("ART Retention, Defaulter Tracing", "PrEP", "ZAIMARA")
    )
  )

ggplot(sa_plot_wide) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_col(aes(x = lb, y = fct_rev(label)), fill = "#1f3bff", width = 0.32) +
  geom_col(aes(x = ub, y = fct_rev(label)), fill = "#c62d12", width = 0.32) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```
